business_rules.rule: Active customers shall be eligible for migration.
Duplicate customers shall be identified using normalized email and phone.
IN, IND and India shall normalize to INDIA.
A and ACTIVE shall normalize to ACTIVE.
Negative credit limits shall be rejected.
Invalid email addresses shall create a data-quality exception.
Unknown customer status shall require review.
Every order must reference an existing migrated customer.
COMPLETE and COMPLETED shall normalize to COMPLETED.
Negative order amounts shall be rejected.
Missing mandatory order dates shall be quarantined for review.
No rejected record may silently enter F2.
Every migration decision must generate traceable evidence.
Production activation is prohibited during this reference test.
